newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack falls on regulation concerns.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack falls on regulation concerns.

text.p: Shares in Railtrack Plc fell on Tuesday, as did most UK utilities, amid concern the newly elected Labour Party would impose burdensome regulation on the sector, dealers said.
By 0918 GMT, Railtrack shares were off 10-1/2p to 426.
Elsewhere, shares in Powergen Plc slipped 2-1/2p to 628, while shares in Severn Trent Plc eased 6-1/2p to 735.
Dealers said there was concern that newly appointed deputy prime minister John Prescott and DTI minister John Battle would not prove friendly to the privatised utilities.
A report in the Independent newspaper said a shake-up of utility regulation, putting greater emphasis on consumer interest, will be a high priority for the DTI. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
